article.title: 'Pete Rose of Kalshi?' Expelled GOP ex-lawmaker gets lifetime ban from prediction market
article.summary: Prediction market Kalshi announced Monday it has permanently banned former Rep. George Santos – the company's first-ever lifetime ban – after regulators accused the scandal-plagued Republican of profiting from betting on himself.The Commodity Futures Trading Commission had accused Santos of posting misleading statements in February about whether he would attend President Donald Trump's State of the Union address and making more than $17,000 by placing bets on the outcome,reported the Wall Street Journal.Kalshi's compliance division also imposed a $71,356 penalty, according to a filing on the company's website.A spokeswoman said the ban stemmed from Santos's failure to fully cooperate with its internal investigation.Santos can appeal to the CFTC, which separately settled its own case against him in July, when he agreed to pay more than $35,000.According to the agency, Santos bought contracts betting he would not attend after severe weather threatened his travel, then sold them for a ...
